hypothesis_a: Prunable channels in a convolutional network can be identified by measuring channel redundancy within each layer independently (e.g., via filter-magnitude/geometric-median criteria), without accounting for redundancy relationships across different layers.
hypothesis_b: Channel redundancy for pruning should instead be measured jointly across multiple different layers rather than within a single layer alone, which better minimizes the resulting accuracy loss.

hypothesis_a: Prunable channels in a convolutional network can be identified by applying an L1-norm sparsity-inducing penalty to batch-normalization scaling factors during training, shrinking unimportant channels' factors toward zero.
hypothesis_b: Prunable channels are better identified using a polarization regularizer on the scaling factors instead of a plain L1-norm penalty, since polarization explicitly pushes each factor toward either zero or a large nonzero value, creating a clear margin between pruned and kept channels rather than uniform shrinkage.

hypothesis_a: A student neural network can acquire a teacher network's knowledge through the standard knowledge distillation paradigm, in which the student learns only from the teacher's outputs and information otherwise available to the student itself.
hypothesis_b: Beyond standard teacher-student distillation, model accuracy can be further improved by having the student also learn from privileged information: additional information available only during training (not to the deployed/student model), used for similarity control and knowledge transfer.

hypothesis_a: Backdoors can be injected into text-to-image diffusion models by poisoning the text prompt data used to fine-tune the model's text encoder, so that a trigger phrase causes the encoder to produce an attacker-chosen embedding.
hypothesis_b: Text-to-image diffusion models can instead be backdoored through multimodal (image-text) data poisoning that fine-tunes the UNet denoising component, rather than the text encoder, to embed the backdoor trigger behavior.
